verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents protected branches, protected tags, merge-request approval rules, or a requirement that pipelines pass before merge. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: generic compliance controls, human-in-the-loop approvals for AI agent sessions, and AI MR review instructions. Branch protection is a fair axis for a Git platform, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can protect branches and tags with rules requiring reviews and passing checks before merge
